REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
AMEND (T) AND RECOMMIT TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

Title: Allows licensees to sell wine or liquor at retail to certain other licensees for resale for consumption off the premises
Summary: Allows licensees to sell wine or liquor at retail for consumption off the premises to certain other licensees; allows such other licensees to resell such wine or liquor for consumption off the premises.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the alcoholic beverage control law, in relation to allowing licensees to sell wine or liquor at retail for consumption off the premises to other licensees, and allowing such licensees to purchase and resell wine or liquor at retail for consumption off the premises
